title: Deformations and Massless Spectra of Smooth Deligne–Mumford Stacks
exact_target: Define deformations and massless spectra for string theory on stacks so that they agree with the associated physical theories.

status_qualification: The original registry excerpt also includes infrared agreement of different quotient presentations, separately catalogued at ID 30000363. Both aspects of the excerpt are retained by this note. Ordinary stack deformation theory can fail to match the physical deformations, as the report's C^2/Z_2 example demonstrates.
